summary: Iteration 5 — Frontend-only verification of 3 new features requested (Item bulk-upload with opening-stock, Reorder List tab in Inventory, Archived tab in Admin). All 3 features work end-to-end. Regression on Inventory and Admin tabs passes. (1) Masters > Items > bulk-item-btn opens bulk-dialog-item with 4-step wizard header (Download Template -> Upload & Validate -> Preview & Confirm -> Summary). bulk-template-item triggers download of item-bulk-upload-template.xlsx (7445 bytes) and shows success toast 'Template downloaded'. (2) Inventory > tab-inv-reorder renders reorder-table with the required columns (Kitchen, Code, Item, Category, Current, Reorder, Max/Par, Suggested Order, Status), reorder-location-filter (shadcn Select) defaults to 'All Locations' and lists Main Store, Base Kitchen, Normal Kitchen, R&D Kitchen; reorder-table-export-btn (CSV) present; help banner 'Daily reorder list — items at or below their reorder / minimum level per kitchen. Suggested Order tops each item back up to its max (par) level.' visible; 1 row returned by default query. (3) Admin > tab-a-archived renders archived-table with 6 archived rows including Items (ITM-BULKTEST1, ITM-CHICKEN, ITM-OIL, ITM-ONION), Brand TB1, Kitchen intent INT-00001 — restore-<kind>-<ref> buttons all present. Clicking restore-items-ITM-BULKTEST1 opens confirm-dialog ('Restore this entry?' with item name/type), confirm-delete-btn (labelled 'Restore') triggers success toast 'Item ITM-BULKTEST1 restored' and the row disappears from archived-table (verified in-page). Regression: all 9 inventory tabs (store/base/normal/rd/ledger/transfer/adjustment/reorder/batches) and all 5 admin tabs (users/audit/cleanup/archived/settings) click through without crash or console error.
critical_code_review_comments: Reorder list default view had only 1 row across all kitchens — expected given current seeded data (most items at par). Confirmed empty-state (reorder-table-empty testid) exists and works.

Restore flow correctly re-uses shared confirm-dialog + confirm-delete-btn testids; consider adding a distinct data-testid like 'confirm-restore-btn' to disambiguate from delete actions in future automation, but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised flows (3/3 new features + regression)

seed_data_creation: Restored ITM-BULKTEST1 (Bulk Test Onion) out of archived back into operational items list as part of test 3. Remaining archived rows: ITM-CHICKEN, ITM-OIL, ITM-ONION, TB1, INT-00001.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature testids confirmed: bulk-item-btn, bulk-dialog-item, bulk-template-item, bulk-close-item (Masters/Items); tab-inv-reorder, reorder-info, reorder-table, reorder-table-search, reorder-location-filter (shadcn Select — click and use option text), reorder-table-export-btn, reorder-table-empty (Inventory); tab-a-archived, archived-table, restore-<kind>-<ref> (kinds seen: items, brands, intents), confirm-dialog + confirm-delete-btn (Admin). File-upload path in BulkUpload item flow was not exercised end-to-end with a crafted xlsx — backend was verified via curl per main agent's note.
